**Finding submitted — deviation (T4C), preferred level.**

- **Investigated:** Paragraph 18 in full (18.1 p0228, 18.2 p0229, 18.3 p0230, 18.4 p0231, 18.5 p0232–p0233, 18.6 p0234, 18.7 p0235) plus a document-wide search for all termination language (including the default/capacity-reclamation clause at p0256).
- **Problem:** No convenience exit for us during the 25-year Initial Period — 18.1 permits unilateral exit only at/after the end of the Initial Period on one year's notice, and 18.2 requires unanimous written agreement mid-term. That is walk-away territory under T4C, so fallback is failed.
- **Counterparty side already better than the playbook requires:** the other Parties likewise have no mid-term convenience right and must give a full year's notice at term end, so element 4 is marked already_met from p0228 and left untouched (no double-flagging with RENEWAL).
- **Cure:** one insert (new Subparagraph 18.8) giving Teleglobe USA Inc. alone a 30-day convenience termination with a pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts. Drafted outside Subparagraph 18.1 so the no-capital-cost-credit rule (18.5) and continuing-liability tail (18.7) remain intact, and no mid-term exit is handed to the other Parties.
